The Authentic Name

Scholarly reference for Theōría

Greek

Θεωρία

The name in its original Greek form. Θεωρία carries the full phonetic and orthographic weight of the source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

THEORIA

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Theōría

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
theōría.com → xn--thera-2sa48d.com

The non-ASCII characters in Theōría are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Theōría. PUNICODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why Theōría is classified as Tier-1

The Greek original Θεωρία contains both stress AND at least one long vowel, and one historically dominant Unicode restoration exists. This is the full scholarly orthography — a single-tier Tier-1 name.
